description: This file defines configuration classes and enums for setting up and managing test clusters in the Orleans framework, including options for silos, transport types, and cluster parameters.

classes.name: TestClusterOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for setting up a test Orleans cluster, including cluster IDs, ports, and transport settings.

classes.name: TestSiloSpecificOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration for individual silos within a test cluster, such as ports, endpoints, and silo names.

classes.name: ConnectionTransportType
classes.description: Enumeration defining the transport methods available for silo and client communication, including TCP, in-memory, and Unix socket.

methods.name: ToDictionary
methods.description: Converts the cluster options into a dictionary of string key-value pairs for configuration purposes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of TestSiloSpecificOptions with appropriate port and endpoint settings based on the cluster configuration.
